CHECK (erased_at IS NULL OR erased_at >= created_at)

CHECK (expires_at > authorized_at AND expires_at <= (authorized_at + '00:15:00'::interval) AND (status = 'active'::text AND revoked_at IS NULL OR status = 'revoked'::text AND revoked_at >= authorized_at))
FOREIGN KEY (mapping_id) REFERENCES control_plane.did_mappings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (policy_snapshot_id) REFERENCES control_plane.policy_snapshots(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (result_id) REFERENCES control_plane.idempotency_results(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (expires_at = (created_at + '00:01:00'::interval) AND (response_status = 200 AND result = 'authorized'::text AND error_code IS NULL OR (response_status = ANY (ARRAY[400, 406, 413, 415])) AND result = 'rejected'::text AND error_code = 'invalid_request'::text OR response_status = 401 AND result = 'rejected'::text AND error_code = 'rejected'::text OR response_status = 409 AND result = 'rejected'::text AND error_code = 'conflict'::text OR response_status = 503 AND result = 'rejected'::text AND error_code = 'unavailable'::text))

CHECK (last_seen_at >= created_at AND last_seen_at <= absolute_expires_at AND idle_expires_at = LEAST(last_seen_at + '00:05:00'::interval, absolute_expires_at) AND absolute_expires_at = (created_at + '00:15:00'::interval) AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at AND revoked_at <= (absolute_expires_at + '00:00:30'::interval)))
FOREIGN KEY (mapping_id) REFERENCES control_plane.did_mappings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (jti_use_id) REFERENCES control_plane.jti_uses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (credential_expires_at > decision_clock AND credential_expires_at <= (decision_clock + '00:15:00'::interval) AND retained_until = (credential_expires_at + '00:00:30'::interval) AND created_at >= decision_clock)
FOREIGN KEY (policy_snapshot_id) REFERENCES control_plane.policy_snapshots(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (expires_at = (created_at + '00:05:00'::interval) AND (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at AND consumed_at <= expires_at))
FOREIGN KEY (envelope_id) REFERENCES control_plane.encrypted_envelopes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (signed_at <= verified_at AND verified_at <= created_at AND fresh_until >= created_at)
CHECK (expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= (created_at + '00:02:00'::interval) AND (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at AND consumed_at <= expires_at))
FOREIGN KEY (mapping_id) REFERENCES control_plane.did_mappings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
